question: Can the stored sample still be analysed?
context: Protocol L4: a sample may wait up to six hours at 4 °C or below, but only two hours between 4 °C and 10 °C.

evidence.text: The storage log shows the sample at 8 °C.
It has been stored for four hours.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: time limit that applies at the logged temperature
